questions.question: Nirmala Mehta is an exponent of which Indian classical dance form?
questions.solution: Nirmala Mehta is a distinguished exponent of Manipuri classical dance. She is known for her mastery of the Ras-Lila and for preserving the graceful, lyrical movements that define this Northeastern dance tradition.

questions.question: Padma Shri Guru Mayadhar Raut’s pioneering spirit revived which of the following dances in 1950s and redefined the grammar and Abhinaya vocabulary of the dance form?
questions.solution: Guru Mayadhar Raut played a monumental role in the revival of Odissi in the 1950s. He is credited with redefining its grammar, systemizing the Abhinaya (expression) vocabulary, and bringing the dance form from the temples to the global stage as a structured classical art.

questions.question: Name the classical dancer who was awarded the ‘Sangeet Natak Akademi Award’ in 1966 for his contribution to Odissi.
questions.solution: Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra was honored with the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1966 for his immense contribution to Odissi. He was a central figure in the 20th-century revival of the dance and was later the first person from Odisha to receive the Padma Vibhushan.

questions.question: Who among the following Indian Carnatic musicians received the Padma Vibhushan award in 1991 and established the Academy of Performing Arts and Research in Switzerland?
questions.solution: Dr. M. Balamuralikrishna was a Carnatic music legend who received the Padma Vibhushan in 1991. Beyond his vocal prowess, he was a prolific composer and philanthropist who established the Academy of Performing Arts and Research in Switzerland to spread Indian music internationally.

questions.question: Kanaka Raju was awarded Padma Shri in 2021 for contribution to which of the following dance forms?
questions.solution: Kanaka Raju, a veteran tribal dancer from Telangana, was awarded the Padma Shri in 2021 for his lifelong dedication to Gussadi dance. He has spent decades training younger generations in this traditional dance of the Raj Gond community.

questions.question: Soorya Classical Dance Festival is held in , __________ for 10 days every year.
questions.solution: The Soorya Classical Dance Festival is a prestigious 10-day cultural event held annually in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. It is organized by the Soorya Stage and Film Society and features top-tier performers of various Indian classical dance forms.

questions.question: Kum Kum Mohanty received the Padma Shri award for her contribution to which of the following dance forms?
questions.solution: Kum Kum Mohanty is an eminent Odissi dancer and a disciple of Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra. She received the Padma Shri for her contributions as both a performer and an administrator (having served as the Director of the Odissi Research Centre).

questions.question: Rukmini Devi Arundale, awarded with Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1957, was a _________ dancer.
questions.solution: Rukmini Devi Arundale was a visionary Bharatanatyam dancer and the founder of Kalakshetra. Her Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1957 recognized her efforts in removing the social stigma attached to the dance and establishing its modern classical identity.

questions.question: Famous classical dancer Vidyagauri Adkar is recognised with ____________ Gharana of Indian classical dance form.
questions.solution: Vidyagauri Adkar is a prominent Kathak dancer associated with the Jaipur Gharana. This gharana is particularly known for its focus on complex footwork (Tatkar), multiple spins (Chakkars), and powerful rhythmic compositions.

questions.question: The title of Asthana Narthaki (‘Resident Dancer’) was bestowed upon by the Tirumala Tirupathi Devasthanam temple to whom among the following prominent dancer?
questions.solution: The prestigious title of Asthana Narthaki (Resident Dancer) was bestowed upon Yamini Krishnamurthy by the Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanam (TTD). She is a legendary figure who excels in both Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi.

questions.question: Guru Shyama Charan Pati, was conferred the Padma Shri for his contributions to mainly which of the following dance forms?
questions.solution: Guru Shyama Charan Pati was a maestro of Chhau nritya, specifically the Seraikella style. He was awarded the Padma Shri (2006) for his role in maintaining the traditional mask-making and performance techniques of this art form.

questions.question: Who among the following is the recipient of Sangeet Natak Akademi for Bharatanatyam?
questions.solution: Geeta Chandran is a celebrated Bharatanatyam artist and a recipient of the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award. She is the founder of the Natya Vriksha dance company and is known for her innovative choreographies that bridge tradition and modernity.

questions.question: Pandit Sunder Prasad who was awarded with the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1959 was a ______ dancer.
questions.solution: Pandit Sunder Prasad was a legendary maestro of Kathak and a key figure of the Jaipur Gharana. He received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1959 for his mastery over the intricate rhythmic patterns and technical aspects of the dance.

questions.question: Famous Folk dancer Gulabo Sapera was conferred Padma Shri award for her contribution to which of the following dance forms?
questions.solution: Gulabo Sapera is the world-famous folk dancer who brought the Kalbeliya dance of Rajasthan to international fame. She was awarded the Padma Shri (2016) for preserving this nomadic snake-charmer community's cultural heritage.

questions.question: Kalamandalam Kalyanikutty Amma was an Indian Classical Dancer of _________ dance form.
questions.solution: Kalamandalam Kalyanikutty Amma is often referred to as the 'Mother of Mohiniyattam'. She was instrumental in resurrecting Mohiniyattam from near-obscurity in the 20th century and providing it with a formal structure and curriculum.

questions.question: Which of the following dances is anchored in the Vaishnava faith of the Meiteis?
questions.solution: Manipuri classical dance is deeply anchored in the Vaishnava faith of the Meitei people. The performances often depict the Ras-Lila (the divine love of Radha and Krishna) and other devotional themes from the life of Vishnu.

questions.question: A colossal architecture with finely carved rock sculptures Arjuna Tapasya in the backdrop of ___________ is a venue for the Mamallapuram Dance Festival.
questions.solution: The Mamallapuram Dance Festival takes place in front of the Arjuna's Penance (Arjuna Tapasya), a massive open-air rock relief. This UNESCO World Heritage site is located on the shores of the Bay of Bengal in Tamil Nadu.

questions.question: Padma shri Ananda Shankar Jayant, is renowned for her significant contributions to which of the following dance forms?
questions.solution: Ananda Shankar Jayant is a renowned Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi dancer. A Padma Shri awardee, she is celebrated for her technical brilliance and her inspirational journey as a cancer survivor who used dance as a healing force.

questions.question: Kishori Amonkar is famous for which of the following music?
questions.solution: Kishori Amonkar was a legendary Hindustani Classical vocalist belonging to the Jaipur-Atrauli Gharana. She was known for her innovative approach to ragas and was one of the foremost singers of the 20th century.

questions.question: Guru Bipin Singh was a _________ dancer awarded with Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1966.
questions.solution: Guru Bipin Singh was a titan of Manipuri dance. He received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1966 and is credited with creating many of the solo compositions used in modern Manipuri dance performances.

questions.question: Uma Sharma was conferred the Padma Bhushan award for enriching which of the following forms of Classical Dances in India?
questions.solution: Uma Sharma is a veteran Kathak dancer who received the Padma Bhushan for her creative contributions. She is famous for reintroducing the 'Nattuvari' style and for her expressive performances of the poems of Ghalib and Tagore.

questions.question: Who among the following invented and perfected India’s classical dance form Sattras?
questions.solution: Srimanta Sankardev, the 15th-century saint and social reformer, is the creator of Sattriya dance in Assam. He developed the dance as a medium for propagating Vaishnavism through the Sattras (monasteries).

questions.question: Which of the following dance forms is performed by Guru Vempati Chinna Satyam?
questions.solution: Guru Vempati Chinna Satyam was a legendary teacher who revolutionized Kuchipudi. He refined the dance form, introduced new solo choreographies, and founded the Kuchipudi Art Academy in Chennai to train thousands of students.

questions.question: C V Chandra Shekhar was conferred the Padma Bhushan for his contributions to which of the following forms of Dance?
questions.solution: C.V. Chandrasekhar is an eminent Bharatanatyam dancer, choreographer, and musician. He was awarded the Padma Bhushan for his academic and performance-based contributions to the field of classical dance.

questions.question: Modhera Dance Festival is an annual cultural phenomenon in the _________ district of the state of Gujarat.
questions.solution: The Modhera Dance Festival (also known as Uttarardh Mahotsav) is held annually at the Sun Temple in the Mehsana district of Gujarat. It showcases various classical dance forms against the backdrop of the stunning 11th-century architecture.
